input: Original text prompts, no input images or third-party model geometry

spec.name: Abbey attendant H1 pilot
spec.canon_boundary: Dead attendants continuing duties are canonical; exact melee/art configuration is a proposed conservative implementation under owner autonomous asset-production authorization.
spec.purpose: Dry duty-hall service humanoid; readable one-handed melee foundation for H1 ordinary enemies. No new role or lore symbols.
spec.reuse_decision: Existing Horde skeleton has useful geometry but third-party standalone public-source redistribution remains unresolved; this original body avoids copying that source. No unrelated character sources are duplicated.
spec.tool: Separate authored tool mesh and grip socket; no fused held object in generated body
spec.prompt: Full body of a gaunt bald medieval maintenance worker with human proportions. Strict T-pose: straight arms horizontal, elbows straight, palms down, open hands away from body, straight legs apart. Sleeveless waist-length work vest, fitted trousers with two clearly separate legs, ankle boots, plain belt and small iron buckle. Bare head, visible neck, forearms and hands. Dry sunken face, bony cheeks, undead appearance. Grounded gothic realism. No hood, robe, skirt, cape, long sleeves, armour, weapon, prop, floor, pedestal, scenery, text or glow.
spec.negative_prompt: Exclusions included in prompt; no separate parameter assumed
spec.animation_policy: Use bundled walk/run first; local idle/turn and pose proof before paid catalogue action. No custom action submitted without exact catalog match.
acceptance: Measure downloaded GLB counts and maps
Verify closed/usable clear humanoid geometry and skin suitability
Rig only after textured geometry face evidence
Compare12k/6k silhouette and deformation; do not enforce low count at cost of joints
FreshGLBimport and Blender pose tests; runtime-native/mobile/RT remains separate gate
spec.status: Second geometry trial prepared as a source candidate
spec.reason: v01 ignored short-clothing and pose instructions; rejected before texture/rig. Worker-first positive description replaces religious silhouette cues.
